card_1.description_en: Target must send a random selfie photo right now!
card_1.description_id: Target wajib kirim foto selfie random saat itu juga!

card_2.description_en: For 15 minutes, target must reply to chats with weird words/typos added.
card_2.description_id: Selama 15 menit, target balas chat wajib pakai tambahan kata aneh/typo.

card_3.description_en: Target must send 1 random or worst meme/sticker.
card_3.description_id: Target wajib kirim 1 meme random/stiker paling jelek.

card_4.description_en: Target must send a voice note singing a kids song.
card_4.description_id: Target wajib kirim VN nyanyi lagu anak-anak.

card_5.description_en: Vent freely for 20 minutes, target can only say 'Yes, you're right'.
card_5.description_id: Pengguna ngomel bebas, target cuma boleh bilang 'Iya, kamu bener'.

card_6.description_en: For 30 minutes, target must call you 'Sir/Ma'am' or 'Boss'.
card_6.description_id: Selama 30 menit, target wajib panggil dengan sebutan 'Paduka/Bos'.

card_7.description_en: Target must type 'I really love you so much' using their nose without correcting typos.
card_7.description_id: Target wajib ngetik 'Aku sayang banget sama kamu' pakai hidung tanpa hapus typo.

card_8.description_en: For the next 5 messages (while active), reply to chat using poems/rhymes.
card_8.description_id: Untuk 5 chat ke depan (selama aktif), balas pesan pakai pantun.

card_9.description_en: Target must send 10 funny pose photos within 2 hours with funny captions.
card_9.description_id: Target wajib kirim 10 foto pose kocak dalam 2 jam dengan caption lucu.

card_10.description_en: Target must listen to a 1-hour voice call, casual conversation allowed.
card_10.description_id: Target harus dengarkan panggilan suara 1 jam penuh, boleh obrolan biasa.

card_11.description_en: Vent as much as you want for 90 minutes, target must listen and reply seriously.
card_11.description_id: Curhat sesuka hati selama 90 menit, target harus dengarkan dan membalas serius.

card_12.description_en: Plan a surprise date for 2 weeks, target doesn't pay but must show up.
card_12.description_id: Rancang surprise date untuk 2 minggu, target gak perlu belanja tapi harus datang.

card_13.description_en: Target must immediately send a smiling photo and stop sulking right now.
card_13.description_id: Target wajib langsung kirim foto senyum dan batal ngambek detik itu juga.

card_14.description_en: Change target's contact name to something embarrassing for 24 hours. Must screenshot.
card_14.description_id: Tentukan nama kontak memalukan di HP target selama 24 jam. Wajib SS.

card_15.description_en: Ask target for one small favor and they cannot refuse.
card_15.description_id: Minta tolong satu hal remeh dan target tidak boleh menolak.
